verdict.rationale: Check has no documented bulk-export or offboarding feature. Its own tools do return data in open formats: the CLI emits JSON by default, which can be piped through jq and Unix tools (check-docs-30, check-docs-31), and the MCP server documents generating a CSV of employees (check-docs-29). That is real but thin support for getting data out. missing for 10: a documented full-account data export, explicit coverage of all data types (payrolls, tax documents, benefits), a documented account-exit or migration process, and independent corroboration.
